quotations.old_english: Is ús tó behealdanne, þæt wé onwarigan þæt þǽra yfela and þǽra unríhta ne sý tó feala
Is mycel þearf ǽghwylcum men tó onwariganne þæt hé þis symle hæbbe on gemyndum

source_text: on-warian to take heed, beware :-- Is ús tó behealdanne, þæt wé onwarigan þæt þǽra yfela and þǽra unríhta ne sý tó feala, Verc. Först. 105, 4. Is mycel þearf ǽghwylcum men tó onwariganne þæt hé þis symle hæbbe on gemyndum, 109, 10.
